capabilityCatalog.note: Since 2026-11-06 (user decision) allowed during a workout, as the mod menu is: the activity is saved and the unfinished workout restarts from its countdown on the new route (ERG on). The phone warns first.

Requested by the user on 2026-11-06. Only the native Select path; the mod engages ERG itself. Like the mod menu, it replaces a running workout (the phone warns first; the old workout bot is retired). Workout.End stays forbidden.

Requested by the user on 2026-11-06 (right-click on the PC window map). PC window only: the bridge refuses phones with FORBIDDEN_SCOPE. GTA natives only (no GTBikeV member). Mod active, game in control and no course loaded.

Requested by the user on 2026-11-06 (right-click on the PC window map: mark the route to a destination). PC window only. Sets GTA's own map waypoint (SET_NEW_WAYPOINT); the game draws the GPS route. GTA natives only. Not during a course.
GET /api/v1/addons: registry of add-ons with typed parameter descriptors, their values, state, run progress and last result.

Requested by the user on 2026-11-07 (Add-ons tab; contract also for the PWA and Android). Starts/stops an add-on run by the adapter (GtbikeV1Addons.cs) with GTA natives only: blips, markers, weather, wind, collision and health reads. No GTBike V member is written; GTBike V itself reads the game wind and weather and turns them into trainer resistance and grip. Start needs the mod active, the game in control, no course loaded and the rider on a bicycle. Phones and the PC window.
Typed parameters from the add-on registry (bridge/api-v1/addons.mjs, mirrored in GtbikeV1Addons.cs); liveEdit false ones only while stopped. The adapter persists them in v1/addons-settings.json.

Removes one ghost segment, its record and its traces (files of the companion only, never GTBike V data).
Requested by the user on 2026-11-07 (Discover: places saved from the PC map). Stored by the adapter in v1/discover-places.json; XP progress in v1/discover-progress.json. Phones and the PC window.

PC window only. SET_WAYPOINT_OFF. Not during a course (it could remove guidance the mod set).

Requested by the user on 2026-11-06 (gtbikev.com configuration page; groups [main] and two [network] switches only). GET/POST /api/v1/mod-config, not a command: the bridge edits GTBikeVConfig.ini itself, only while GTA V is closed (GAME_RUNNING otherwise; the mod rewrites the whole file from memory on every save), with revision check and backup. Allowlist only: no [keys], [devices], [user] or URLs; multiplayer is an on/off switch (NONE / official server). config.write (arbitrary INI writes) stays forbidden.

forbiddenAdapterMembers.evidence: GTBikeVScript.cs:1742 (activates ERG at 1773). P13 reaches it only by raising WorkoutSelectionView.OnWorkoutSelected, like the native Select button, on the mod's own Tick.
GTBikeVScript.cs:1250 re-calls OnWorkoutSelected for unfinished workout

workout-not-finished.rule: Reject with WORKOUT_PC_CONTROL_REQUIRED when Multiplayer.CurrentActivity.Workout != null && !Workout.Finished.
workout-not-finished.reason: SaveCurrentActivity (GTBikeVScript.cs:1564) and course initialization call CreateNewActivity, which re-invokes OnWorkoutSelected and re-engages ERG.

modSetActiveGuard.rule: Native ActivateModHandler (GTBikeVScript.cs:1425) is a toggle on IsDTOK. enabled=true allowed only if IsDTOK==false and no receiver in {initialized, started, complete, stopping}. enabled=false allowed only if IsDTOK==true and no receiver in {stopping}. enabled equal to observed state is a no-op that reaches 'applied' without invoking the handler.
